_about: Issue catalogue shown in the Lab's Open issues panel (CONTRACTS 9.5). Maintained by Claude alongside plans/v26.2.md; the user's close/reopen/comments live in LAB_DIR/issues-state.json. Keep ids stable.

items.title: DA2 depth squashes range beyond ~12 m
details: depth/ground 0.64 at 20–30 m, 0.39 at 30–60 m; sky ~12 m.
Distant buildings land at 6–12 m and make false wall faces.

items.title: Face/edge test: precision 0.82, recall 0.73 at ≤ 10 steps
details: Walls beside the path still give some calls: #137 at 26.33 s pushes back the ✗ 28.50 "person at 12:15 in 6".
The low sea wall is missed.

items.title: Chest-0004's 10.9 s building is said late (~12.3 s)
details: With the default `depth` it is said at ~12.3 s; only ground+depth says it at 10.83 s.

items.title: ✓ 150.50 "building at 12:45 in 3" is said earlier
details: Said at 144.33 instead, and the repeat is suppressed.

items.title: Ground modes lose ~12 ✓ against depth
details: ground-contact / ground+depth lose ~12 ✓, mostly at step thresholds tuned on raw depth.

items.title: Snap and coasting side effects
details: A pole in front of a facade can be pulled to a nearer wall corner.
Coasting can announce a returning vehicle one frame early.

items.title: World map: stale wall votes where nothing is seen (v26.2.5)
details: Cells the current frame neither sees as ground nor covers with a face ray keep old wall votes until they decay (Chest-0004 120 s: a wedge behind the hand).

items.title: World map: clearing may remove some real wall (v26.2.5)
details: At 105 s barrier-wall cells dropped 512 → 194; most were the stale cloud, not checked cell by cell.
Far false faces from the depth squash (O1) are now drawn as clearer lines.

items.title: World map: small objects missing from the object layer (v26.2.6)
details: Chest-0004 0 s: the sidewalk-obstacle item at 1.6 m ahead / 0.6 m right has no object cells on the map (empty / sidewalk there).
Since v26.2.6 a click on its marker reads it, but the map cells and the collision rules that read the map still miss it.

items.title: Beeps near people
details: A person within 5 steps with unknown motion beeps, even 2–3 steps beside the path (`unknownMotionBeepSteps`, `movingLaneHalfWidthM`; v26.1.12).
A receding person we catch up on gets no beeps; you ticked those at 43.2 s.

items.title: Finals: rule 6 vs rule 9b
details: Finals for named things come back (rule 6), while finals for never-named context things inside a danger run go silent (rule 9b). The two pull in opposite directions (v26.1.16).

items.title: Vehicles: the 2.0 m/s own-speed level
details: It drops 7 unreviewed "vehicle approaching" phrases on the full run (v26.1.16).

items.title: Reach at the start: people at 13 steps
details: People 13 steps away in the first 1.8 s are not said, because of the 10-step reach (v26.1.15).

items.title: Camera side windows
details: Portrait left/right windows see no walking surface, because the seed box is straight ahead. A "faces forward" mode is the alternative.
Landscape left/right equal center (v26.1.15 follow-up).

items.title: Head-mounted footage untested
details: `Head-center-0001…0011` were never tested with the head calibration.
The crosswalk tones were not mined on head footage.
The IMU body heading hook (`_walking_axis_offset_m`) is unused.

items.title: Ego motion
details: The walking speed (cadence × step) reads 1.4–1.8× fast; the cadence harmonic is suspected.
Turning in place reads as walking (302.8 s).

items.title: Mover depth
details: Mover closing speeds use raw (uncorrected) depth.
Lateral rate does not separate moving from static (re-try with depth).

items.title: World map
details: Minutes-long drift is untested.
Ghost beeps have never fired on real footage and are untuned.
There is no Chest-0002 map run; it was skipped while the GPU trained, and the GPU is free now.

items.title: Portrait windows
details: Items cut by the window edge are not flagged as clipped.
Depth runs on the window crop.

items.title: Roadmap steps 3–5
details: Traversability, then 2.5D, then the learned layer.

items.title: Apple port
details: Only after the Lab logic matures (user, 2026-10-17). The mobile depth model path also belongs here.

items.title: HackEye-Models curation and retrain
details: Curate frames with the X model, then retrain the app model (720p/l is the candidate).

items.title: Device calibration profiles
details: Per device + lens mode + mount: lens intrinsics (checkerboard clip), mount height/tilt, raw-depth → metres correction curve (chalk marks 2–20 m).
Gives a correct scale from frame 0 and attacks the far-depth squash (O1); per-frame scale still refines on top.
Apple app: ARKit motion tracking gives metric scale per frame (no LiDAR needed).

items.title: The 10.9 s building
details: Now handled by the map; the timing is tracked under O3.

items.title: Walls/fences as lane dangers
details: Covered by the v26.2.2 face/edge test.

items.title: Sound parameters by ear and "kerb"
details: You tune these with the v26.1.16 sound tuner.

items.title: Chrome macOS speech fix
details: Unconfirmed, but no reports since.
